summary.text: Angela Romero is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served as state House minority leader since January 17, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Angela Romero grew up in Tooele, Utah.
She earned a B.S. in political science in 1998 and an M.P.A. in 2010, both from the University of Utah.
Her career experience includes working as a government coordinator, youth and families program coordinator, and community programs manager for the Salt Lake City Corporation.

Romero served as vice chair of the Utah Martin Luther King Jr. Human Rights Commission, was secretary of the Salt Lake Democratic Party, and joined the boards of the Utah Coalition of La Raza and the Salt Lake People's Market, according to Ballotpedia.
